trajectory.patch:
drivers/adc/Kconfig.adc_emul
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
config ADC_EMUL
	bool "ADC emulator"
	default y
	depends on DT_HAS_ZEPHYR_ADC_EMU_ENABLED
	help
	  Enable the ADC emulator driver. This is a fake driver in that it
	  does not talk to real hardware. It pretends to be actual ADC. It
	  is used for testing higher-level API for ADC devices.
========
config ADC_EMUL
	bool "ADC emulator"
	default y
	depends on DT_HAS_ZEPHYR_ADC_EMU_ENABLED
	select DT_COMPAT_ZEPHYR_ADC_EMUL
	help
	  Enable the ADC emulator driver. This is a fake driver in that it
	  does not talk to real hardware. It pretends to be actual ADC. It
	  is used for testing higher-level API for ADC devices.
